channel.title: Space Digest

item.title: Yes, Protestants Can Pray the Rosary. Here's How.

item.title: #2562 - Dan McClellan
item.description: The Bible emerges as a changing record of politics, older myths, disputed texts, and evolving ideas about God.

item.title: Building Defense for the Agentic Era: Kevin Mandia
item.description: AI is turning cyberattacks into high-speed experiments that human defenders may not be able to match.

item.title: #2561 - LL Cool J

item.title: Beyond the God Model | Alex Atallah & Amjad Masad
